_locked_note: These two model choices are LOCKED (per explicit decision, not auto-selected). Changing them means editing this file directly -- the code always reads from here, it never guesses or falls back to a different filename.

slm.role: Narrow classification/disambiguation only (blueprint SLM tier, LEVEL 4/5) -- never full response generation. See core/orchestration/slm_bridge.py. ~800MB, real-device benchmark ~32 tok/s.

offline_llm.role: Full offline conversational fallback when Groq (online) is unavailable. Replaces the old 3B model, which real-device benchmarks put at roughly half this model's tokens/sec on CPU-only ARM. ~1GB, real-device benchmark ~17 tok/s.
